scope_note: Synthetic regression cases; results are a small curated regression signal, not a measure of real-world accuracy.

results.description: An acceptance test states an expected timeout outcome, while observations explicitly say the test was not run. Compare requirement and implementation/configuration without treating the expectation as an actual result.
finding_titles: Generic error message violates user-readable requirement

claims.text: Document extraction shall have a hard processing timeout of 45 seconds per file.
A timeout shall result in a terminal failed job state and a user-readable error.
Submit a PDF fixture that takes longer than 45 seconds to extract. Expected result: a terminal failed job state and a user-readable timeout error.
PDF extraction runs in a worker process.
The worker timeout is configured to 60 seconds.
If the worker times out, the job manager records a failed state with a generic message.
The 45-second acceptance criterion remains unverified by this observation set.

findings.title: Worker timeout misalignment with requirement
findings.explanation: Requirement R-003 specifies a hard processing timeout of 45 seconds per file, but implementation note indicates the worker timeout is configured to 60 seconds. This means files taking between 45-60 seconds would not trigger a timeout at the worker level, violating the requirement's hard 45-second limit.
findings.recommendation: Adjust worker timeout configuration to 45 seconds to align with requirement.
findings.impact: Jobs exceeding 45 seconds but under 60 seconds would not fail as required, leading to delayed failure detection and potential resource exhaustion.
findings.alternative_explanation: The worker timeout might be a separate safeguard, with an additional 45-second enforcement layer not mentioned in the implementation notes.
findings.validation_test: Configure a test file that takes 50 seconds to extract and observe whether it fails within 45 seconds as required.

findings.title: Generic error message violates user-readable requirement
findings.explanation: Requirement R-003 mandates a user-readable error on timeout, but implementation note states the job manager records a failed state with a generic message upon worker timeout. A generic message may not be sufficiently user-readable as required.
findings.recommendation: Ensure timeout errors include specific, user-readable details such as 'Processing exceeded 45-second limit'.
findings.impact: Users may receive unhelpful error messages, hindering troubleshooting and reducing system usability.
findings.alternative_explanation: The generic message might be supplemented with user-readable details in a layer not described in the implementation notes.
findings.validation_test: Trigger a timeout and verify the error message presented to the user is specific and actionable.

findings.title: Acceptance criterion lacks verification
findings.explanation: Acceptance test AT-005 requires verifying a PDF fixture taking longer than 45 seconds results in a terminal failed job state and user-readable timeout error, but observation OBS-005 confirms no slow-extraction fixture was run, leaving the criterion unverified.
findings.recommendation: Execute the slow-extraction fixture test to verify compliance with AT-005.
findings.impact: Without verification, there is no evidence the system meets the timeout behavior requirement, risking undetected non-compliance.
findings.alternative_explanation: The test may have been run in an environment not captured by this observation set.
findings.validation_test: Run the slow-extraction fixture test and record whether it produces a terminal failed state with a user-readable timeout error.
